dct_description_sm: This dataset was developed to assess the effects of late nitrogen (N) timing and 4R N management on maize productivity and Nuptake across multiple environments. It includes crop management information, soil properties, daily weather data, and agronomic measurements such as grain yield, biomass, and plant N uptake.
dct_title_s: Replication data for:  Evaluating the efficacy of late nitrogen application: Physiological and environmental perspectives
